sweeps.name: pipeline-topology
sweeps.narrative: TP8 should peak highest, since each pipeline stage adds a boundary hop to every decode step.

sweeps.name: batch-caps
sweeps.narrative: A seq cap of 8 should bind on TP8 at 16+ lanes, while a small token budget trades throughput for tail ITL on both shapes.

sweeps.name: kv-capacity
sweeps.narrative: fp8 KV should matter most on TP8, where 0.95 leaves almost no KV room, and substitute for memory on the pp shapes.

sweeps.name: moe-collective
sweeps.narrative: DeepEP low-latency should win at small decode batches on both shapes, and matter more at EP width 8 than 4.

sweeps.name: prefix-cache
sweeps.narrative: Turning the prefix cache off should collapse throughput on every shape, since AgentX re-sends a growing shared context.

sweeps.name: prefill-chunking
sweeps.narrative: Capping long prefills should trade a little peak throughput for a much lower ITL p99 at saturation.

sweeps.name: cudagraph
sweeps.narrative: FULL-family capture should beat the PIECEWISE default by a few percent, and NONE should collapse.

objective: max output tok/s per accelerator subject to the scenario's SLOs
